text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Tokai Stakes has<n>arrived.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ooh, how exciting. The race is about<n>to begin.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Come on, Windy! You can win this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The racecourse is bustling with eager<n>spectators.
As for Shinko Windy...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes are shut tight. By visualizing<n>the track in
the darkness of her mind,<n>she's plunging herself
into a state of<n>deep concentration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've practiced this technique<n>countless times
now. As a result, her<n>precision and focus have both
improved considerably.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna put the urge to win at the<n>center of my
mind.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The spectators and other racers<n>don't matter. All I
need to do is run to<n>the finish line. All right!
choice_data_list: Do your best. I know you've got this!
